newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Viatel started by Lazard.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Viatel started by Lazard.

text.p: - Lazard Freres & Co said Monday it initiated coverage of Viatel Inc with a buy rating.

- The provider of network services is in a good position to compete for business when Europe opens its $100 billion telecommunications services market to competition in 1998, Lazard analyst John Hodulik said in a research report.

- Viatel has an early start over new competitors with nine switches in operation in Europe. The company, which went public with an initial stock offering in October, will use part of the offering's proceeds to install additional points-of-presence in 17 Western European cities next year, the research report said.
- Viatel is trading below the IPO price of $12 a share. There is a chance for "substantial appreciation" due in part to the company's appeal to potential acquirers, Lazard said.
- Viatel's shares were off 1/8 at 10 in afternoon trade.
